need: Written before opening the document: in the Preface, what rule does Johnson give himself about quoting living authors? This is a compound document — the volume's parts (Preface, Grammar, and each headword) have their own titles, and the pages carry signature marks rather than folios, so the printed page number is genuinely absent.
query: Johnson preface my purpofe was to admit no teftimony of living authors partiality

alternates.quote: My purpofe was to admit no teftimony of living authors, that I might not be mifled by partiality
